Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: The second half of Gordon Ryan's open guard series: playing from your back, in eight volumes. Volume 1 covers the four scenarios and the inside/outside interface. Volumes 2 and 3 cover ashi X versus X guard, switching from irimi ashi to ashi X, and countering the back step from ashi X and full X guard. Volume 4 covers De La Riva (tripod sweep, entering ashi garami when the sweep fails). Volume 5 covers the no-gi berimbolo (cross body ride entrance, forcing upper back exposure). Volume 6 covers reverse De La Riva (reverse tripod sweep, entering the legs). Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi open guard players who play on their back.

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's mount in eight volumes. Volume 1 covers getting to mount, starting with isolating the near arm from side control. Volume 2 covers mount maintenance (hips up versus down, feet positions). Volume 3 covers countering pushes and bridges, lifting the elbows and cross-wrist grips. Volume 4 covers the seated head-and-arm position, the back triangle and five submissions from it. Volume 5 covers cross wrist to underhook and kata gatame (arm triangle) finishing mechanics. Volume 6 covers high mount, S-mount and separating the hands. Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi top players who get to mount and want to finish from it.
